_about: Herodotus in English, translator per title. G. C. Macaulay (prose, 1890): vol. 1 is already held on the Adler shelf (herodotus-history, PG 2707) and is cross-referenced; vol. 2 (PG 2456) is fetched here, completing him. George Rawlinson (1858-60, with notes and essays by H. C. Rawlinson and J. G. Wilkinson), the 4-vol. 1861 New York printing, raw IA OCR. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).
